source_title: TxDMV Motor Carrier Division — Oversize/Overweight Permits (43 TAC Chapter 219)

superload_thresholds.note: Standard single-trip permits cover up to 254,300 lbs gross. Superheavy = over 254,300 lbs, OR 200,001-254,300 lbs with under 95 ft of axle spacing, OR any single axle/axle-group over max permit weight; requires TxDOT Bridge Division route + bridge/pavement analysis (apply 3-4 weeks ahead). Dimensional loads over 20' wide, 18'11" high, or 125' long require route-inspection certification on file before issuance.

width.note: 1 escort over 14' up to 16' wide — front on 2-lane, rear on multilane (43 TAC 219.11)
1 front + 1 rear escort over 16' wide, all roads

height.note: 1 front escort with height pole over 17' high
2 escorts over 18' high; front escort must carry a height pole

length.note: 1 escort over 110' up to 125' long — front on 2-lane, rear on multilane
1 front + 1 rear escort over 125' long, all roads

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip base permit = $60 (flat). Loads over 80,000 lbs add a highway-maintenance fee by gross-weight bracket: 80,001-120,000 lbs +$150 (total $210); 120,001-160,000 +$225 ($285); 160,001-200,000 +$300 ($360); 200,001+ +$375 ($435). Loads over 200,000 lbs add a $35 vehicle-supervision fee. Superheavy adds a $500 outside-engineer report review (or $100 if no bridges crossed). Texas.gov surcharge: $0.25 + 2.25% per transaction.
single_trip.note: Overweight is axle-configuration driven — permit weight is set by axle count/spacing, not gross alone (e.g. permit single axle 25,000 lbs, five-axle group 81,400 lbs); exceeding per-axle/group maxima pushes a load to superheavy/structural review.

annual.note: Annual Company/Vehicle-Specific Envelope $4,000/yr (up to 12'W, 14'H, 110'L, 120,000 lbs). Annual Over-Axle/Over-Gross-Weight Tolerance permit = $90 base + $5 admin + county-tier fee ($270 for 1-5 counties up to $1,095 for 101-254 counties); tolerances axle +10%, gross +5%.

movement_restrictions: Daytime movement only, except overweight-only loads, or loads at/under 10' wide and 100' long moving on the Interstate (43 TAC 219.11)
Holiday movement limited to loads at/under 14' wide, 16' high and 110' long (unless a route/traffic-study exception applies)
Operators must observe TxDMV-published county and district (metro rush-hour) curfew restrictions issued as 'Permit Restrictions by County & District'
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 14'0", gross 80,000 lbs; Texas allows a 59' semitrailer in a two-vehicle combination. Axle limits: single 20,000 / tandem 34,000 / triple 42,000 / quad 50,000 lbs.

Fees, escort matrix, superheavy thresholds and legal limits confirmed from official TxDMV.gov permit pages and 43 TAC 219.11 (Texas Administrative Code). Governing handbook: TxDMV Motor Carrier Handbook, May 2025.
